relationships.subject: Chondroitinase ABC
relationships.evidence_quote: WFA+ PNNs were no longer visible after local injection of ChABC

relationships.subject: Chondroitinase ABC
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment in both regions attenuated the reduction in mechanical and thermal pain thresholds in CCI mice without affecting pain thresholds in SO mice

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-9 is a major PNN-degrading enzyme and is involved in the pathophysiology of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased PNN density caused by MMP-9 knock-down was associated with reduced mechanical and thermal pain thresholds in healthy animals

key_findings: Neuropathic pain (CCI) increases WFA+ PNN density in contralateral SSC, mPFC (incl. ACC), RTN and insula
ChABC in SSC or RTN attenuated CCI pain threshold reduction; MMP-9 siRNA lowered thresholds in sham mice
